# Château de la Huberdière

> A 3-star boutique hotel in a 16th-century château, in the heart of the Loire Valley, in Touraine, at Nazelles-Négron near Amboise (Indre-et-Loire, France). It combines the spirit of a guesthouse with the service of a hotel. Weddings, stays, corporate seminars, retreats and workshops, family gatherings and private events. 2 hours 20 from Paris.

## Facts

- 3-star boutique hotel (Atout France classification) in a 16th-century château, in Touraine, 2 hours 20 from Paris and 10 minutes from Amboise.
- 10 characterful rooms, each with a private bathroom. Sleeps 21 when the whole château is booked exclusively.
- Private walled grounds of 14 hectares: pond, terraces, heated swimming pool.
- Booking.com rating 9.5/10 (120 reviews) and Google 4.9/5 (99 reviews).
- Homemade breakfast included, fresh and local produce.
- Evening table d'hôte for guests: sharing boards every evening except Sunday, Italian dinner on Thursdays (by reservation).
- Weddings: exclusive use of the estate, guests staying on site, receptions for 30 to 150 people.
- Less than an hour from Chenonceau, Villandry, Chambord, Amboise and Clos Lucé.

## Practical information

- Address: Vallée de Vaugadeland, 37530 Nazelles-Négron, Indre-et-Loire, France
- Phone: +33 2 47 57 52 92
- Email: contact@chateaudelahuberdiere.com
- GPS coordinates: 47.44645, 0.93489
- Check-in from 4 pm, check-out until 11 am

## Offers

- [Stay at the hotel](https://www.chateaudelahuberdiere.com/en/sejour): nights in a boutique hotel near Amboise, an ideal base to visit the Châteaux of the Loire.
- [Wedding at the château](https://www.chateaudelahuberdiere.com/en/mariage): wedding ceremonies and receptions in a private estate in the Loire Valley.
- [Corporate seminar](https://www.chateaudelahuberdiere.com/en/seminaire): seminars and professional events in Touraine.
- [Family gatherings](https://www.chateaudelahuberdiere.com/en/famille): rent the whole château for reunions, large gatherings and weekends with friends.
- [Retreats and workshops](https://www.chateaudelahuberdiere.com/en/retraite): a venue for yoga retreats, wellness courses and masterclasses.
- [Table d'hôte](https://www.chateaudelahuberdiere.com/en/restauration): dinners at the château for resident guests.

## Frequently asked questions

- Are you a hotel or a guesthouse? A 3-star boutique hotel, with the spirit and welcome of a guesthouse.
- How many people can the château sleep? 21 people in 10 rooms, with exclusive use of the whole estate.
- How far from Paris? 2 hours 20 from Paris, 10 minutes from Amboise and 30 minutes from Tours.
- Can we view the château and rooms without booking? Yes, each room is shown in detail with photos; dates are only requested when you book.
